author: Kristi_L

title: A great way to learn about Sangria making while seeing the harbour.
text: A great tour with professional and friendly staff. The other 5 ladies from the US made it fantastic. The meeting point was poorly advertised. It stated the address as 103 but this is the address of the total marina complex. The meeting point should have indicated the dock number and the name of the vessel.
author: dale022016

title: Relaxing Time Along the Barcelona Coast
text: My wife and I booked this tour somewhat last minute while looking for tours to do in Barcelona and we were super grateful that we did. We ended up having a private sailing tour along the Barcelona coast with John and Albert who were extremely entertaining, courteous and thoughtful. They were knowledgeable about the sangria making process while also being able to capture candid photos of the tour and scenery. At the end, they even gave a huge list of recommendations for different sites to see and places to eat. 10/10 would highly recommend enjoying this tour with John and Albert!
